intentionalDeviations: Process Lab uses the run grid as the Step sample rate and does not expose vector parameters or zero-crossing options.

mappings.supportedSubset: Finite scalar internal initial condition without reset, limits, wrapping, or external state ports.
intentionalDeviations: Process Lab uses controlsys LTI simulation and does not expose solver, reset, saturation, or external initial-condition ports.

mappings.supportedSubset: Finite scalar internal initial condition and one-sample delay.
intentionalDeviations: This milestone retains Process Lab's explicit 0.1 second new-block sample-time default until inherited-rate analysis has a model-level base-step adapter.

oracle.description: The documented defaults produce 0 before 1 second and 1 at and after 1 second; these values are analytic and are not MATLAB output.
For constant input u and internal initial condition x0, y(t) = x0 + u*t; expected values are analytic and are not MATLAB output.
The first sample-period output is the internal initial condition and later outputs are the previous input sample; expected values are analytic and are not MATLAB output.
